mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 8 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 9, low 6.

Premier League clubs request new probe into Manchester City finances focusing on post-2018 period, risking renewed tension in English football.

At least seven Muslim legislators have won seats in the U.S. Congress, marking a historic increase in Muslim representation in both the House and the Senate.

Kosovo's European Commission commissioner highlighted that the country has recently intensified the implementation of its Reform Agenda, a key step toward EU accession.

Tennis legend Rafael Nadal has been appointed to the board of directors of Real Madrid, with the club confirming his membership and upcoming voting rights.

A cyberattack targeted French blood-bank storage facilities, attempting to raise refrigeration temperatures, but authorities neutralized the threat before any samples were damaged.
